brief: "Kiln & Quire": a two-person letterpress and risograph print studio in Kyoto that sells limited-edition prints and runs weekend workshops. Page: landing page — hero plus ONE scroll section introducing the weekend workshop. Audience: design-literate tourists and locals. The owners hate "zen minimalism" clichés.

"Gale": an open-source time-series database built for wind-farm telemetry (millions of turbine sensor readings per second). Page: launch landing page — hero plus ONE section explaining ingest speed. Audience: infrastructure engineers. It must not look like every other dev-tool site.
